# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 59 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 59 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_059_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 5, Part 5 — The Full Key to the Parable

**59:1** I asked him to explain all the parables and visions I had seen. He said: "I will explain everything I show you. Just give me your full attention — heart and mind — and everything I say will become clear."

**59:2** "Here is the key. The field is this world. The lord of the field is the One who created everything, brought it to completion, and gave it power. The son is the Holy Spirit. The slave is the Son of God. The vine is the people God planted. The fences are the holy angels of the Lord who protect his people. The weeds removed from the vineyard are the sins of God's servants. The food sent from the feast represents the commandments he gave his people through his Son. The friends and counselors are the holy angels who were created first. And the master's absence represents the time still remaining before he comes."

**59:3** "Lord," I said, "all these things are extraordinary and glorious. Could I have ever figured this out on my own?" He said: "Anyone who truly has God in their heart would not have hesitated to ask, and would not have gone without an answer. But I will explain it to you."

**59:4** "Now hear the full picture. The slave whom the master honored and made the principal heir of all his goods — that is the Son of God. The counselors are the first-created angels. The master's absence means the remaining time before his return. The cultivated vine is the people of God. The fences are the angels who guard them. The weeds removed are the people's sins. The food from the feast is the commandments given through the Son. And the friends are the holy prophets who served God."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, making the allegorical key of Similitude 5 fully transparent.*
